name: Flowing Menu
rationale: Clean-room implementation from the one-line description "Flowing menu treatment" only; no upstream source was read and the GSAP tweens are replaced by direction-aware CSS transitions and one CSS marquee loop.

speed.description: Seconds for one full marquee loop inside the band.

duration.description: Time the band takes to flow in or out, in ms.

repeat.description: Label copies in each half of the marquee.

height.description: Row height (any CSS length); the label size follows it.

open.description: Start open when a toggle button is present.

a11y: Every row is a real <a> inside a <nav>; the band and its marquee copies are aria-hidden, so each link is announced once by its own text.
Keyboard focus plays the same flow as hover, and a :focus-visible outline is drawn inside the row so overflow never clips it.
The optional toggle is a real <button> whose aria-expanded tracks the list; Escape closes the list and returns focus to the toggle.
Reduced motion shows the band in place with a still marquee, and forced-colors mode paints it in Highlight and HighlightText.
